thread.text:
Today: Deadlift beat the prescription outright — 70kg × 8 matched Thursday's top-set pattern, then you pushed into 80kg × 6, 6, well past the 72.5kg step the plan allowed. Pull-ups ran +8kg × 7, 6 then bodyweight × 6 (19 total), a different load profile than the bodyweight-only slot 2 call, and down from 26 on 10-22. The row held flat at 40kg × 8, 8, 8, identical to 10-22. Straight arm pulldown repeated 17.5kg × 10, 10, 10, same as last time. Dips jumped straight to +10kg × 8, 8, 8, ahead of the bodyweight progression the plan still had you on. Crossover ran three sets at 11.25kg × 12, 12, 12, a different number from the prescribed 10kg re-entry. Curl sat at 30kg × 8, 8, 7.

Trend: The row is now flat across two sessions (10-22, 10-29) at 8, 8, 8 — needs 10s across the board for the 42.5kg bump. Straight arm pulldown is likewise parked at 10, 10, 10 for two sessions, bottom of the 10-12 range, so no increment yet. Barbell curl has read 8, 8, 7 three times now (09-13, 09-17, 10-29), still stalled at 30kg.

Next session: Upper C, Sat 31. Bench press dumbbell at 24kg × 10-12, 2 in reserve, back to 28kg next Saturday. Chest supported row trial 3 of 4 at 16kg. Lateral raise anchor 7kg × 15-20 across three sets, back to 8kg next week. Deadlift strength is clearly ahead of the table right now — worth carrying that confidence into bench and row if the first sets feel easy.

Question: the pull-up slot ran weighted first, then dropped to bodyweight for a lower total than usual — was that a deliberate test of load on the Thursday slot, or did the first two sets cost you reps you'd normally bank bodyweight?
the first two sets tired me out

That tracks — slot 2 bodyweight has been giving 26-27 total lately (10-22: 26, 09-24: 27), and today's 19 is a real drop once you load the first two sets. The instruction for this slot is bodyweight specifically because it's the lighter Thursday pull-up day; adding +8kg first changes the demand on the set that's supposed to stay fresh.

Worth flagging to your coach: if you want to test weighted pull-ups here, it probably needs its own slot or instruction rather than sitting inside a bodyweight-anchor day, since it's eating into the number that slot is tracking.
